$meta.name: AURA widget schema
$meta.purpose: Describes every AURA widget type so a JSON widget/tab config can be generated and pasted into the dashboard editor ("Widget importieren").
usage: A widget object needs id, type, title, datapoint and gridPos.
gridPos is in grid cells, not pixels: x/w are columns, y/h are rows. The column count is NOT fixed — it follows the dashboard width and the configured horizontal snap, so take it from the prompt.
options accepts the keys under widgets.<type>.options plus every key listed in widgets.<type>.commonOptions (defined once under commonOptions).
layout must be one of widgets.<type>.layouts; omit it for "default".
An option marked "datapoint": true must be an existing ioBroker state id — never invent one.
Names referenced as "ref" are defined under types.
A missing "description" means the key is only documented by its name, type and default.

title.description: Überschrift des Widgets. Ein Datenpunkt in doppelten eckigen Klammern zeigt seinen Wert, z. B. "Wohnzimmer [[0_userdata.0.Temp]] °C" — der Titel folgt dem Wert live.

datapoint.description: ioBroker-State-Id. Leerstring bei Typen mit addMode "free" (Uhr, Überschrift, Gruppe …).

gridPos.description: Position und Größe in Rasterzellen: x/w Spalten, y/h Zeilen. Die Spaltenzahl ist nicht fest — sie folgt der Dashboardbreite und der Raster-Einstellung und steht im Prompt.

titleAlign.description: Ausrichtung des Titels: left, center oder right.

icon.description: Lucide-Icon-Name (z. B. "Lightbulb", "Thermometer"). Leer = Standard-Icon des Typs.

contentPosition.description: Position des Inhalts in der Karte als Zweibuchstaben-Code aus Zeile (t/c/b) und Spalte (l/c/r), z. B. "cc" = zentriert.

batteryDp.description: Datenpunkt für den Batteriestatus (Badge in der Ecke).

unreachDp.description: Datenpunkt für die Erreichbarkeit (Badge in der Ecke).

lockDp.description: Datenpunkt für die Kindersicherung (Badge in der Ecke).

conditions.description: Regeln, die Aussehen und Sichtbarkeit des Widgets vom Wert eines Datenpunkts abhängig machen (Farbe, Icon, Titel, Textgröße, ausblenden).

badges.description: Kleine Marker in der Ecke des Widgets, gespeist aus einem Datenpunkt. Der Stil "label" kann Datenpunkte im Text zeigen: "{0_userdata.0.Pool.MaxRun} min".

clickAction.description: Was ein Klick auf das Widget auslöst: ein Popup öffnen oder springen (Tab, Widget, externe URL). Schreibt KEINEN Datenpunkt — dafür ein schreibendes Widget nehmen (chips, Listenzeile mit displayType "momentary"/"switch", enum, httpRequest). Die Varianten stehen unter ClickAction.

transparency.description: Deckkraft der Karte in Prozent (100 = voll deckend).

styleOverride.description: CSS-Variablen nur für dieses Widget, z. B. { "--accent": "#f00" }.

colorThresholds.description: Schwellenwerte, die den Wert je nach Höhe einfärben.

unit.description: Einheit hinter dem Wert, z. B. "°C", "%", "kWh".

decimals.description: Nachkommastellen. Ohne Angabe gilt die globale Einstellung.

numberFormat.description: Tausender-/Dezimaltrennzeichen. Ohne Angabe gilt die globale Einstellung.

valueFactor.description: Rohwert wird mit diesem Faktor multipliziert, bevor er angezeigt wird.

valueOffset.description: Dieser Wert wird nach dem Faktor addiert.

elements.description: What the rule does to the widget's elements while it matches (issue #96).

effect.description: `border` pulses the frame alone, so the content stays readable.

notify.description: Send a message when the rule fires — same edge semantics as refreshWidget (issue #429). Stored as the builder draft so the editor can re-open it.

reflow.description: if hiding: remove from grid so other widgets slide up

value.description: always string; parsed numerically where needed

valueType.description: when 'datapoint', `value` is the second DP ID

ringColor.description: Colour of the pulsing ring — only read by the effect `border`.

bold.description: Whole-card text style. Not a CSS variable — see the .aura-cond-* rules.

show.description: `undefined` leaves the visibility alone, `true` shows the element (and opens the content fields), `false` hides it. The only way to hide — there is no second switch for it.

text.description: Replaces the text of the title resp. the value.

color.description: Appearance. Travels as a class + variable on the frame root, read by the .aura-cond-* rules in index.css against the class every widget puts on its title/icon/value — so it needs no wiring per widget type. `bold`/`italic` and `fontSize` are meaningless on the icon and not offered there (the icon has `iconSize` instead).

fontSize.description: Text size in px. undefined = the size the widget renders the element at.

showTime.description: Timestamp override. '' = take the admin default, 'off' = force it away, a format = show it in exactly that shape. One control instead of a toggle plus a format select, because "show it" is never asked without "in which shape".

corner.description: which edge/corner the badge sits on

color.description: dot/pill colour (CSS); falls back to var(--accent)

dp.description: 'count': datapoint ref (supports JSON path) whose live value is shown

label.description: 'label': the text. Carries the same datapoint bindings as free HTML, so the marker can state a value: '{0_userdata.0.Pool.MaxRun} min', '{dp} °C' for the widget's own datapoint, '{id;round(0)}' through operations, '{{ a + b }}' as an expression (see utils/badgeLabel and utils/htmlTemplate).

variants.description: Lists every datapoint that sits under the same parent / channel / device as the clicked one. `dp` overrides the source datapoint (default: the widget's own, or the clicked list row's).

ClickAction.description: Was ein Klick auf das Widget (oder auf eine Listenzeile) auslöst: ein Popup öffnen oder irgendwohin springen. Es gibt bewusst KEINE Variante, die einen Datenpunkt schreibt — wer eine Taste braucht, die einen Wert setzt, nimmt ein Widget, das schreibt: "chips" (chips[]: dp + value, die Szenen-/ Aktionsleiste), eine Listenzeile mit displayType "momentary" (Taster), "switch", "buttons" oder "states", das "enum"-Widget für feste Werte, oder "httpRequest" für einen Webhook. popup-dimmer/-thermostat/-switch/-shutter/-mediaplayer sind Altbestand und werden beim Rendern auf popup-view mit der eingebauten View umgeschrieben; neu immer popup-view mit viewId.

colSizes.description: Optional per-column CSS grid-template-columns track sizes (e.g. 'auto', '1fr', '60px'). Length must equal cols.

rowSizes.description: Optional per-row CSS grid-template-rows track sizes (e.g. 'auto', '1fr', '40px'). Length must equal rows.

text.description: 'text' / 'button' type: static text content / button label

fieldKey.description: 'field' type: key into widget-supplied extraFields map

componentKey.description: 'component' type: key into widget-supplied extraComponents map

decimals.description: 'value' / 'dp' type: decimal places override (undefined = use global)

numberFormat.description: 'value' / 'dp' type: thousands separator override (undefined = use global)

valueTransform.description: 'dp' / 'progress' type: selected transform preset id (editor only; disambiguates presets sharing factor/offset)

valueTimeFormat.description: 'dp' type: render the value as time/date (see TIME_DISPLAY_PRESETS); undefined = plain value

valueTimePattern.description: 'dp' type: token pattern, only used when valueTimeFormat is 'custom'

conditions.description: per-cell conditional formatting (Universal Widget) — reacts to the cell's own or a foreign DP value

allowOverflow.description: allow text to overflow into adjacent cells

wrap.description: wrap long text onto multiple lines instead of ellipsis (default false)

colSpan.description: 'component' type: how many grid columns to span (1..cols)

imageUrl.description: 'image' type: static URL or base64 data URI (fallback when dpId is empty)

imageWidth.description: 'image' type: explicit width in px (undefined = fill cell width)

imageHeight.description: 'image' type: explicit height in px (undefined = fill cell height)

valuePosition.description: 'slider' cell: where to render the current DP value (default 'none')

sendValue.description: payload sent to dpId on click (parsed as bool/number/string)

trueIcon.description: 'state-icon' / 'switch' (icon mode): Lucide icon for truthy value

falseIcon.description: 'state-icon' / 'switch' (icon mode): Lucide icon for falsy value

stateMode.description: default 'boolean' (truthy coercion: true/1/'true'/'1'/'on'); 'condition' uses operator + value

stateValue.description: 'condition' mode: comparison value (parsed numerically where needed)

statusDpId.description: 'switch' cell: read-back DP — state, label and colours come from here while clicks still write to dpId (split command/status devices, issue #567)

buttonTrueColor.description: 'switch' cell (button mode): background for truthy value (falls back to color)

buttonFalseColor.description: 'switch' cell (button mode): background for falsy value (falls back to color)

buttonTrueTextColor.description: 'switch' cell (button mode): label color for truthy value (falls back to buttonTextColor)

buttonFalseTextColor.description: 'switch' cell (button mode): label color for falsy value (falls back to buttonTextColor)

buttonSize.description: 'switch' cell (button mode): padding scale in px (default 8)

buttonWidth.description: 'switch' cell (button mode): 'auto' fits text, 'full' fills cell, 'uniform' matches widest sibling button (default 'auto')

momentary.description: 'switch' cell: Taster-Modus — write trueValue on press, falseValue after delay

confirmAction.description: 'switch' cell: require confirmation overlay before toggling

confirmText.description: 'switch' cell: optional prompt text in confirmation overlay

trueValue.description: 'switch' cell: payload written when switching ON  (parsed as bool/number/string; default true)

falseValue.description: 'switch' cell: payload written when switching OFF (parsed as bool/number/string; default false)

dateFormat.description: DateOutputFormat string: how to encode the picked date when writing to dpId

dateInput.description: 'datepicker' cell: native pickers (default) or a free-text pattern field

dateInputPattern.description: token pattern typed into the field when dateInput === 'custom'

showTime.description: show time-of-day picker alongside date input

timeOnly.description: hide date input, only edit/write time-of-day

multiline.description: 'input' cell: render a multi-line textarea instead of a single-line input

submitMode.description: 'input' cell: write on Enter/Send/blur ('submit', default) or on every keystroke ('live')

showSubmit.description: 'input' cell: show the Send button in submit mode (default true)

clearAfterSubmit.description: 'input' cell: command field — clear the field after sending and never show the DP value

inputUnit.description: 'input' cell: unit rendered right of the field (issue #622); empty = none. Named apart from the 'unit' cell type, which prints the widget's own unit.

showValue.description: 'progress' cell: overlay current value/percentage on top of bar

trueText.description: 'state-text' cell / 'switch' cell (button mode): label rendered for truthy value

falseText.description: 'state-text' cell / 'switch' cell (button mode): label rendered for falsy value

entriesSource.description: 'select' cell: where the entries come from (default 'manual')

entriesDp.description: 'select' cell: datapoint holding the JSON list (entriesSource 'json'), may carry a ?path

entriesValueKey.description: 'select' cell: field name overrides for the JSON rows (empty = auto-detect)

showSelectedLabel.description: 'select' cell: render current label next to dropdown

hideSelect.description: 'select' cell: hide dropdown and render entries as a button group

entryDisplay.description: 'select' cell: how the current entry is shown (default 'text')

showLastChange.description: show lc timestamp below the cell content

clauses.description: empty `datapoint` = the element's own value; otherwise a foreign DP ref

target.description: Which part of the element to paint. Ignored by custom-grid cells.

color.description: text / icon color — and the fill of a progress or bar-style slider cell

bg.description: element background (the whole cell / row, never the bar of a progress cell)

icon.description: icon override (icon / state-icon cells, list row icon)

iconColor.description: icon colour, when it should differ from the text colour

iconSize.description: icon size in px (list rows / second-line datapoints); undefined = the element's configured size

fontSize.description: text size in px; undefined = the size the element is rendered at

effect.description: Same two effects the widget level offers, applied to this element alone.

notify.description: Send a message when the rule starts matching — once per element, so a rule on a list sends one message per row that triggers (issue #605). Stored as the builder draft, like the widget level's `notify`. The draft may address the element with `{{dp}}` / `{{parent}}` / `{{name}}`; see utils/notifyTemplate.

color.description: The line/bar colour: a theme token (`var(--accent-green)`) like everywhere else, or a fixed value (`#3b82f6`, `rgb(...)`, `red`). A canvas cannot read CSS, so the widget resolves the token at its own element before handing the option to eCharts (hooks/useResolvedColors.ts) — which is what lets a chart follow the theme, a design picked per section and the widget's own `styleOverride`. A token no theme defines resolves to nothing and leaves the built-in palette in charge, which is also what an unset colour does.

stack.description: Stack this series onto the other stacked series of its y axis (issue #541) — e.g. battery discharge + grid draw adding up to the house consumption. Stacks are grouped per axis, since summing values from two differently scaled axes would be meaningless. See `alignStackedSeries` for why the points have to be resampled onto a shared timeline first.

stackOutline.description: Outline a stacked area band with the series colour (default off). Off, because the outline of a band at value 0 lies on the band below it and reads as a curve with no area — see `outlineWidthFor`. Only meaningful for a stacked area.

showValues.description: Draw the value at every data point of this series, overriding the widget-wide `echartShowValues` (issue #584). Unset = follow the widget. A bar chart with a temperature line over it usually wants the numbers on the bars only.

labelInterval.description: Label only every n-th point (default 1 = every point, issue #584). Counted back from the newest point, so the latest value always keeps its label. Only acts where the series has more than one point — a comparison bar is never thinned out.

areaOpacity.description: Fill opacity of an area in percent (10–100), unset = the default of `areaOpacityFor`: a stacked band is opaque so it shows the colour it was given, a single area stays a wash to see through (issue #557). Only meaningful for an area.

historyStart.description: Absolute window override (ms epoch) — set by the widget's day navigation; wins over historyRange.

aggregate.description: getHistory aggregation for stepped fetches (default `average`). `minmax` keeps the real extreme points with their true timestamps — right for sparsely change-logged datapoints (e.g. daily rain counters), where bucket averages smear resets and dropped empty buckets let the chart interpolate across days. `none` disables bucketing entirely and returns the raw logged points — no server-side averaging that could smear a value across a gap. `delta` is for ever-rising totalisers (electricity/water meters): instead of the counter reading it plots the consumption per calendar bucket — see `deltaBucket` (issue #521).

deltaBucket.description: Calendar bucket the `delta` aggregation differences over (default `hour`). `auto` derives it from the active window instead — see `resolveDeltaBucket`.

source.description: Where the series gets its points from. `history` (default) queries a history adapter; `json` reads a JSON array straight out of the datapoint's value — for datapoints that already hold pre-aggregated label/value pairs (issue #509).

jsonPath.description: Dotted path into the parsed JSON value down to the array, e.g. `data.hours`. Empty = root.

jsonLabelKey.description: Object key holding the x category (default `label`).

jsonValueKey.description: Object key holding the y value (default `value`).

jsonAxisPath.description: Dotted path to the object holding the y-axis bounds, e.g. `axis` for `{"axis": {"min": 0, "max": 100}, "data": [...]}`. Empty = look for the block automatically. Only read when the widget has `echartJsonAxisBounds` switched on (issue #550).

valueTransform.description: Display-only value conversion, per series (issue #540): every point, the live value and the current-value block are shown as `raw * valueFactor + valueOffset` — the datapoint and its history records are never touched. Set through the ƒx button next to the series' datapoint; `valueTransform` only remembers which preset was picked (several share a factor, e.g. W→kW and Wh→kWh are both ×0.001). A `delta` series is converted before differencing, so the offset cancels out — as it must: a shifted counter reading consumes exactly as much per bucket as an unshifted one. Its SIGN is applied afterwards instead — see `deltaTransform`.

decimals.description: Decimal places of this series' numbers (issue #600), unset = follow the chart-wide setting in the "Datenpunkte verwalten" dialog (which itself falls back to the global default). A kWh line next to a percentage wants a different precision than the rest of the chart.

numberFormat.description: Thousands separator of this series' numbers, unset = follow the chart-wide setting.

id.description: Stable key stored in valueFilter / backendValueFilter.

icon.description: Iconify id / lucide name shown in the filter menu.

subKey.description: 'sub' / 'both': restrict to ONE extra datapoint, matched against its label, its full id or its last id segment (case-insensitive, `{{parent}}.BATTERY` → BATTERY). Empty = every extra datapoint of the row is a candidate.

every.description: Several candidates (all extra datapoints): require ALL to match instead of one.

subKey.description: 'sub': which extra datapoint of the second line, matched against its label, its full id or its last id segment — the same convention a filter rule's `subKey` uses, so `{{parent}}.BATTERY` is addressed as `BATTERY` in every row. Empty = the first extra datapoint of the row.

mode.description: Default 'auto': numbers numerically, booleans false→true, everything else as text.

values.description: mode 'custom': the value order, first entry first. Values not listed follow behind.

empty.description: Where rows without a value land, regardless of direction. Default 'last'.

valueTransform.description: Preset id, 'custom', or 'none' — the latter switches a list-wide default off.

valueTimeFormat.description: Time output preset id (or 'custom'); undefined / 'none' = plain value.

valueTimePattern.description: Token pattern, only used when `valueTimeFormat` is 'custom'.

switchStyle.description: Control shape: 'slide' = toggle (default), 'icon' = clickable icon, 'image' = clickable image.

trueIcon.description: Icon/image style: shown in the on/true/>0 state. Icon falls back to Power.

falseIcon.description: Icon/image style: shown in the off/false/0 state. Icon falls back to Power.

onImage.description: Image style: picture shown in the on state. Falls back to the on icon.

offImage.description: Image style: picture shown in the off state. Falls back to the off icon.

onValue.description: Value written when switching on. Empty = follow the datapoint (true / 1).

offValue.description: Value written when switching off. Empty = follow the datapoint (false / 0).

statusDp.description: Separate read-back datapoint for devices that split command and status (Tasmota: cmnd.POWER switches, stat.POWER reports ON/OFF). State and colours come from here, every write still goes to the entry's own datapoint.

confirm.description: Switch-like controls (switch, momentary): require a confirmation tap before writing.

confirmText.description: Custom prompt shown in the confirmation overlay. Falls back to a default text.

iconSize.description: Size in px of the row icon (left of the name). Unset = per-layout default.

switchIconSize.description: Size in px of the icon/image switch. Its own key, because a row can show BOTH a name icon and an icon switch (issue #616) — one shared size made the row icon jump to the switch size and hid the row-icon field in the editor. Falls back to `iconSize` so configs written before the split keep rendering unchanged.

shutterMode.description: Shutter control model: - 'commands' (default): separate up/stop/down command DPs (Shelly, Zigbee, scripts). - 'position': single LEVEL DP (the entry's main DP) — up/down write open/close values, stop writes the current position back (HomeMatic-style).

shutterWriteValue.description: Value written to a shutter command DP on press. Default true.

shutterOpenValue.description: Position mode: value written on "up" (open). Default 100.

shutterCloseValue.description: Position mode: value written on "down" (close). Default 0.

shutterActualDp.description: Read-only datapoint reporting the real position (HmIP-BROLL & co.); wins over the entry's own value for the display.

shutterInvert.description: The device counts the other way round: 0 = open.

shutterShowSlider.description: Position slider in the row, next to the buttons.

shutterSliderWidth.description: Slider width in px (row layouts). Default 64; the card fills its cell.

shutterSendOnRelease.description: Write once the drag ends. Default true, like the widget.

shutterLivePreview.description: Let the printed position follow the drag instead of the datapoint.

shutterShowValue.description: Print the position next to the control.

shutterShowClosedPercent.description: Print how far the shutter is CLOSED instead of how far it is open.

shutterTiltDp.description: Slat angle (Neigung): the datapoint written, plus an optional read-only one.

shutterTiltMin.description: Raw values that mean "slats closed" / "slats open". Default 0 / 100.

shutterTiltInvert.description: The device counts the slats the other way round.

shutterTiltLabel.description: Caption of the slat control. Default "Lamellen".

shutterTiltLivePreview.description: Slat preview follows the drag. Default true, like the widget.

shutterTiltSendOnRelease.description: Write the slat angle once the drag ends. Default true.

shutterShowTiltValue.description: Print the slat percentage next to the control.

shutterActivityDp.description: Datapoint reporting that the actuator is driving, and the values that mean it.

shutterDirectionDp.description: Datapoint reporting the direction (1 = up, 2 = down); highlights that button.

shutterLockDp.description: Lock datapoint, shown as a padlock in front of the control.

sliderColor.description: Fill and thumb colour. Unset = the theme accent.

sliderBarStyle.description: Draw the widget's filled bar instead of the native range control.

sliderBarSize.description: Bar style: bar height in % of the layout's base height. Default 100.

sliderThickness.description: Native style: track thickness in px. Unset = the layout's default (4 row / 6 card).

sliderCommitOnRelease.description: Write once the drag ends instead of on every move.

sliderReadOnly.description: Show the value but refuse edits — the control becomes a progress bar. A datapoint that is not writable at all prints its value as text instead.

sliderShowValue.description: Print the value next to the slider. Default true.

sliderShowUnit.description: Append the entry's unit (fallback `%`) to that value. Default true.

sliderShowMinMax.description: Print the scale ends left and right of the slider. Default false.

sliderWidth.description: Row layouts: fixed control width in px. Unset = a compact default (80).

presetsSource.description: 'json' takes the presets from a datapoint holding JSON instead of the list above — the Auswahl widget's second source.

presetsValueKey.description: Field names inside the JSON objects; unset = the parser's own guesses.

presetSelect.description: Render a dropdown instead of a row of buttons (the widget's `showSelect`).

selectShowValue.description: Print the current entry next to the dropdown. Default: only without a dropdown — the closed dropdown already shows the current entry.

selectShowSelect.description: Draw the dropdown. Off = read-only display of the current entry. Default true.

selectEntryDisplay.description: How the current entry is printed: text (default), icon + text, icon only.

selectWidth.description: Fixed control width in px. Unset = hug the current entry (row) / fill the cell (card).

contactPreset.description: Value-mapping preset key (see WC_PRESETS); default 'hmip'. 'custom' uses the contactValues* fields below.

contactValuesClosed.description: Custom comma-separated values per state (only used when contactPreset === 'custom').

contactLockDp.description: Separate lock datapoint (Fenstergriff / Schloss), shown as a small padlock next to the state - the Fenster-/Turkontakt widget's lock display.

tilted.description: The "tilted" state, only reachable with a preset that maps one.

contactAppearance.description: Text, colour and icon per contact state, field by field over the shared defaults (WC_FALLBACK: closed "Geschlossen" #22c55e CheckCircle2, tilted "Gekippt" #f59e0b TriangleAlert, open "Offen" #ef4444 XCircle). This is how a contact row is relabelled for something that is not a window: a heating valve on `contactPreset: "boolean"` becomes `{ closed: { label: "zu" }, open: { label: "heizt", color: "#f59e0b" } }`. Without it the only way to rename a state was the `states` mapping, which is a different display with its own value list.

timeFormat.description: Output shape for the 'time' display (see TIME_DISPLAY_PRESETS); default 'time'.

timePattern.description: Token pattern, only used when `timeFormat` is 'custom'.

dateInputFormat.description: 'custom' replaces the native pickers with a field matching `dateInputPattern`.

dateTimeOnly.description: Only a time field, no date.

dateShowTime.description: Additional time field next to the date.

dateOutputFormat.description: Format the picked value is written in. Default 'timestamp_ms'.

dateOutputPattern.description: Token pattern, only used when `dateOutputFormat` is 'custom'.

pulseValue.description: Value written on press. Default true.

pulseReset.description: Write a reset value after pulseDelay ms (momentary). Default false.

pulseResetValue.description: Reset value written after the delay. Default false.

pulseDelay.description: Delay (ms) before the reset write. Default 500.

pulseLabel.description: Button caption for the momentary control.

inputPlaceholder.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

inputWidth.description: Fixed field width in px. Unset = a compact default (row) / full width (card).

inputMode.description: 'number' parses and writes a number; default 'text' writes the raw string.

inputSubmitMode.description: 'submit' (default) writes on Enter/blur/send button, 'live' on every keystroke.

inputShowSubmit.description: Show the send button in submit mode. Default true.

inputClearAfterSubmit.description: Command-field mode: clear the field after each send and never mirror the DP.

inputTextAlign.description: Text alignment inside the field. Default 'left'.

inputReadOnly.description: Display the value but refuse edits, regardless of the datapoint's writability.

inputMin.description: Number mode: the range the field accepts. Writes are clamped to it.

inputMultiline.description: Multi-line text area instead of a single-line field (turns number mode off, like the standalone widget). Enter inserts a newline, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends.

inputHeight.description: Multi-line: height of the text area in px. Unset = the layout's default.

inputShowUnit.description: Show the entry's unit right of the field. Default false (issue #622).

activeColor.description: Per-DP text color when on/true/>0. Overrides global activeColor.

inactiveColor.description: Per-DP text color when off/false/0. Overrides global inactiveColor.

activeBg.description: Per-DP entry background (row/card/pill) when on/true/>0. Overrides global activeBg.

inactiveBg.description: Per-DP entry background when off/false/0. Overrides global inactiveBg.

fontSize.description: Per-DP label font size in px. Falls back to per-layout default.

showLastChange.description: Show last-change timestamp under this entry.

clickAction.description: Per-row click action. Overrides the list-wide setting; undefined = inherit.

popupTitle.description: Heading of this row's popup. Beats options.rowPopupTitle; unset = the row name.

popupHideTitle.description: Title bar of this row's popup: true = hide, false = show, unset = as the list.

subDps.description: Extra datapoints shown in a second line below this entry — display only. Ignored by the badges (minimal) layout, where a row is a single pill.

divider.description: This row is a separator, not a datapoint: a rule across the full width that opens a new section. It lives in `entries` like any other row, so it is added, dragged, moved and deleted with the same handles — the alternative, a flag on the datapoint below it, would mean switching one entry off and another on just to move a line. `id` is then synthetic (`divider:<n>`) and carries no ioBroker meaning.

dividerLabel.description: Heading on the separator. Empty = a plain rule.

dividerLine.description: Draw the rule(s) next to the heading. Default true; false = heading only.

render.description: Look of the button — the same per-entry options the Auswahl widget offers: text (default), an icon, an image or sanitised HTML.

image.description: Image instead of the icon — the Statusbild widget's per-state picture.

render.description: Look of the mapping: text (default), icon, image or sanitised HTML.
